svg.text: Primary stack + managed heap that is a container of typed Data Stacks • Rust-style ownership (configurable: manual or GC)
When the primary stack ends, the program ends
and ALL stack + heap memory is reclaimed.
Container of Data Stacks – structured allocation space, not one random allocation pool
Mixed content that fits nowhere else
Creates Data Stacks (Single • Mixed • General • String pool • Named type pools) • Grows capacity • Tracks pointers
Releases a whole Data Stack at once • Frees / reuses individual boxes • Handles the General Data Stack
• Every object has a single owner; borrowing via shared / mutable references.
• Object is released when its owner goes out of scope (drop).
• A Data Stack is released as one unit when its owner is dropped.
• Configurable per program or per Data Stack:
Primary stack ends → program ends → all stack and heap memory reclaimed.
Data Stacks group related objects; boxes can be freed individually.
Conceptual diagram – logical allocation regions, not a literal physical memory layout.
